content.title: Anti-inflammatory drugs
content.recommendation: Low-dose colchicine (0.5 mg once daily) may be considered, particularly if other risk factors are insufficiently controlled or if recurrent cardiovascular disease events occur under optimal therapy.
content.notes: Increase statin potency/dose if the patient was on low-potency/low-dose statin; add ezetimibe if the patient was only on statins at highest tolerated dose; or add PCSK9 inhibitor if the patient was on statins plus ezetimibe. Angiotensin receptor blockers in cases of intolerance.
content.abbreviations: ACS (acute coronary syndrome); CKD (chronic kidney disease); HF (heart failure); ICD (implantable cardioverter defibrillator); LDL-C (low-density lipoprotein-cholesterol); LVEF (left ventricular ejection fraction); PCSK9 (proprotein convertase subtilisin/kexin type 9); RAAS (renin–angiotensin–aldosterone system).

Associated Conditions: Use of PCSK9 inhibitors when statins plus ezetimibe are insufficient
genes.context: Appears in the abbreviation list as 'PCSK9, proprotein convertase subtilisin/kexin type 9' and is referenced in a footnote recommending addition of a PCSK9 inhibitor if the patient is on statins plus ezetimibe.
